column1: # Boundary comparisons that keep their shape on purpose, each with the reason.
# Read by scripts/check_boundary_comparisons.py, which refuses a computed
# decimal compared unsettled with a printed limit or with zero (see its
# docstring for the rule and for what it cannot see). Every line below is a
# comparison of that shape that cannot sit on its limit, or whose outcome does
# not change there, and says why. A line that no longer matches a comparison
# fails the guard, so the list cannot outlive what it excuses.
# The reasons marked "(recorded with the fix)" are the ones recorded site by
# site when the class was settled; the others were reviewed when this check
# was written. Nothing belongs here because settling is
# inconvenient: a comparison that can sit on a printed limit is settled
# One entry per line, four tab-separated fields: the file below
# src/phonometry, the enclosing function as Class.method, the comparison as
# written (whitespace collapsed), and the reason. A line excuses one
# comparison: a function that writes the same comparison twice lists it
# twice, so a third copy added later is refused.
